give me a step wise guide. how to make this website easily and where to paste these codes

Creating a simple medical firm website using the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript you provided involves several steps. Below is a detailed guide on how to set up your project and paste the necessary code files.

### Step 1: Set Up Your Project Directory
Create a new folder on your computer where you'll keep all the files for this project. Name it something like `medical-firm-website`.

Inside this folder, create three subfolders:
- **css** (for styles.css)
- **js** (for script.js)
- **images** (optional, if you plan to include images)

### Step 2: Create the HTML File
In your main project folder, create a file named `index.html`. This is where you'll write your HTML code. You can use any text editor like Notepad++, VSCode, or Sublime Text for this task.

### Step 3: Add Your HTML Content
Open `index.html` in your text editor and start adding the basic structure of your website using the provided HTML code. Here’s a minimal version including the head section where you'll link to your CSS and JavaScript files:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Medical Firm</title>
    <!-- Link to the CSS file -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles.css">
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Your HTML content goes here -->
</body>
</html>
```

### Step 4: Add Your CSS Content
Navigate to the `css` subfolder you created earlier and open `styles.css`. Paste the provided CSS code into this file. Save the file after pasting.

### Step 5: Add Your JavaScript Content
Next, navigate to the `js` subfolder and create a file named `script.js`. Open this file in your text editor and paste the provided JavaScript code. Save the file after pasting.

### Step 6: Update HTML to Link CSS and JS
Go back to your `index.html` file. You need to add internal links for the CSS and JS files you just created, as shown below:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Medical Firm</title>
    <!-- Link to the CSS file -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles.css">
    <!-- Link to the JavaScript file -->
    <script src="js/script.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Your HTML content goes here -->
</body>
</html>
```

### Step 7: Paste the Provided Code into Your Files
Make sure you paste all the provided code snippets correctly into their respective files (`styles.css`, `script.js`, and `index.html`). Double-check for syntax errors to avoid broken links or functionality.

### Step 8: View Your Website
To see your website in action, you can use a local server like **Live Server** in Visual Studio Code (open the folder containing your project files in VSCode and click on "Go Live" at the bottom of the window), or simply open `index.html` directly from your file explorer if viewing locally.

### Step 9: Make Edits and Improvements
Now that you have a basic website, feel free to make edits and improvements as per your requirements. You can add more sections, styles, and functionalities by editing the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files accordingly.

This step-by-step guide should help you create a simple medical firm website easily using the provided code snippets.
